text: Severity-1 outage SLA: 15-minute response, 4-hour resolution. Escalation manager paged at 2-hour mark.
Refund policy: full refund within 30 days of subscription. Prorated after 30 days.
Goodwill credits up to $200 per incident for platform-caused outages.
POST /v2/analytics: JSON body with query and filters. Rate limit 60 req/sec.
GET /v2/customers/{id}: returns tier, status, CSM. 404 for unknown ID.
Auth: Bearer token via Authorization header. Tokens expire after 24 hours.
PII data residency: EU customers in eu-west-1, US customers in us-east-1.
SOC 2 Type 2 report available on request via compliance portal.
Error code MK-5501 indicates malformed query parameters. Check the request body for typos.
Error code MK-5502 indicates a rate limit exceeded. Back off and retry with jitter.
Error code MK-5503 indicates an invalid customer_id. Verify the id exists via GET /v2/customers/{id}.
